performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark 28+ days; organic holding but now fading.

findings.text: All paid spend is $0 for the entire 28-day window — Meta and Google both dark. Zero leads, zero CPL. Revenue engine is off.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned as of 2026-08-31. Engagement is month-to-month lapsed — gates next 3 months of paid activity.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31. Contact-rate bottleneck remains unresolved per SOW CRM milestones.
GBP actions collapsed 80.36% last 7d; last 3 days show 0 actions vs 5–12/day prior — listing suppression or engagement drop now confirmed by 3-day signal.
Search clicks stable at 36–44/day last 3 days; GA4 sessions averaging ~71/day — organic search is holding despite GBP drop, so paid void is the only growth lever missing.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension signature immediately — $0 spend for 28 days is unrecoverable without a signed contract.
suggestions.monday_update: Paid campaigns have been fully dark for 28+ days ($0 spend, 0 leads) and cannot be relaunched without a signed extension. Sohib to contact Marwan this week to confirm or close the engagement. Success check: signed contract on file by 2026-09-11.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing: 0 actions for 3 straight days vs 5–13/day prior — check for suspension or suppression.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 80.36% over 7 days and hit 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-03), down from a 5–13/day run rate. Check the GBP dashboard for a suspension notice, ownership conflict, or flagged content and resolve it. Success check: actions return to ≥5/day within 7 days of fix.
